description: Resume one paused heartbeat: it goes back to PENDING with no deadline, so it is not reported late until its next success ping restarts the clock. Use it once the job runs again; to change its timing use update_heartbeat. There is no bulk resume for heartbeats. Requires a key with the write scope. Resuming one that is not paused resets it to PENDING the same way. Returns the heartbeat.

heartbeat_id.description: The heartbeat's uuid from list_heartbeats. An id that is not a heartbeat of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: resume_heartbeat

state.description: Known values: PENDING, UP, DOWN, PAUSED.

title: Resume a heartbeat monitor
